claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation — create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Major Image creates a persistent multi-sensory illusion at a location. This maps to the v4 'create_object' effect atom, but OngoingOperation only accepts 'roll_modifier' and 'damage_on_hit'. A create_object variant (or create_illusion) is needed so that illusion-creation spells can be encoded as ongoing_effect mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation (or ActivationPhase) — passive ability_check detection
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's detection mechanic is creature-initiated: take the Study action, roll INT (Investigation) vs caster's spell save DC; on success, see through the illusion. The v4 taxonomy has 'ability_check' as a resolution atom, but it is unreachable from any existing surface path. ActivationPhase only has 'attack_roll' and 'save_gate', both of which are caster-initiated. A passive creature-initiated detection grammar is needed on the ongoing effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that takes a Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration — slot-conditioned override (concentration → until-dispelled at slot ≥ 4)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The upcast mechanic qualitatively changes the Duration kind from 'concentration, up to 10 minutes' to 'timed, until dispelled' when cast with a level 4+ slot. No existing SlotScaling<T> type covers a conditional change of Duration kind. This requires a new grammar for slot-gated duration overrides.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.area.shape — cube
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The image's extent is a 20-foot Cube. The cube shape already exists on AnchorTarget.area (for Alarm) but is absent from Attachment.area.shape, which only supports sphere. Adding cube to the Attachment area shape union would let the illusion's bounding volume be expressed honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube.
